question: Will a new Israeli government win a Knesset confidence vote by December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Yes if the Knesset passes a vote of confidence in a new government and it is constituted by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM US Eastern. A failed vote or the caretaker government continuing does not count.

reference_class.description: Israeli elections since 2013 where a government won a confidence vote within 65 days of election day

history.rationale: 10/27/2026 update to the market price 49.5%. No independent news view.

11/07/2026, independent view 20% against the crowd's 30% (22.6% with the bias taken out). Base rate: since 2013, 3 of 7 elections produced a sworn-in government within 65 days of the vote, and none of the four hung results of 2019 to 2021 did (br-israel-election-to-government). This one is hung: no bloc reached 61 and Netanyahu's bloc is the larger one, while Eisenkot holds the reported first mandate. The clock is 28 days plus up to 14, so only a first-mandate success can beat 12/31; a second mandate cannot finish in time. That needs Eisenkot to find 61 across the bloc line in about six weeks. 20% is the hung-result base rate lifted a little for a mandate holder who is the market favorite.

players.does: Negotiates on the first mandate; needs defectors from Netanyahu's bloc or outside support to reach 61.
Holds his bloc together to run out the clock and stay caretaker prime minister.
